case_classification.short_description: Regular financial life plan model including debt, salary raises, tax and inflation in spending categories - the model includes a part two that is a full fletched Combinatorial Scenario Model

ai_time_estimate_reasoning: This wealth management model is highly complex due to the annual tax bracket indexation (brackets inflating by 2% each year), individual lifestyle and price inflation tracking across 11 expense categories, and a tight cash-flow waterfall that coordinates a dynamic cash liquidity target with prioritized debt repayment (credit card vs. student loan) and investment overflows. Additionally, Task 2 requires generating 7,500 multi-dimensional scenarios. An expert modeler will need to write a VBA macro to loop through these 7,500 combinations, run them through the core model, extract the age-100 net worth results, and bin them using COUNTIFs to answer the scenario questions.
